patthana23.54:1.1: dhammaṃ paccayā anidassana appaṭigho maggārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi. sanidassana
patthana23.54:2.1: sappaṭighaṃ na maggahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā anidassana appaṭigho maggahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.54:3.1: na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na maggādhipatiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā anidassana appaṭigho maggādhipati dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi. na sanidassana sappaṭigho na uppanno
